newsitem.title: MEXICO: Apasco 1996 sales volumes rise 5.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Apasco 1996 sales volumes rise 5.0 pct.

text.p: Mexican cement producer, Apasco S.A. de C.V. said on Thursday that sales volumes rose 5.0 percent in 1996 to 5.4 million tonnes compared to the year earlier.
Exports of cement and clinker during 1996 reached 1.2 million tonnes, 18 percent of the total volume, Apasco added.
Apasco's premixed concrete sales volumes in the fourth quarter were 505,000 cubic meters, which brought sales to 1.6 million cubic meters for the year, up 6.0 percent from the year before, it said.
Apasco said sales volume rose about 1.6 million tonnes in the fourth quarter, up 28 percent from the third quarter.
In the fourth quarter of 1996, demand for grey cement in the domestic market grew 16 percent, which pushed up growth for the year by about 4.0 percent compared to 1995, it said.
The company said that exports of cement and clinker to Central America, South America and the Far East in the fourth quarter were 302,000 tonnes, bringing the year total to 1.2 million tonnes.
